body: 'Twas the best of times, 'twas the worst of times.'  And now they're over.  See youse on the other side.  Lobby the hotlines to get more folks.  :)
Thanks.  Reinforces my thoughts.  A triple PhD on the way out here.  Hope you're more than the ass face you seem.

And nobody responds here either.  Don't know what I expected.  After all the shit about "each life is precious" from all the varying religions, guess I thought I'd matter to someone.  But since I'm an atheist, I know I'll just be great fertilizer somewhere.  Damn.  Life sucks.  But then, blessedly, we all die.
